requirement: Map a create-suspected-cause command to a new SuspectedCause model: copy the pathogen id, severity, and treatment site, let the entity generate its id, and always report success.

preconditions.text: The mapper is constructed without dependencies

inputs.text: Command with a pathogen id, severity, and treatment site

returns.text: Success at ApplicationStatus.Success with a new SuspectedCause
Pathogen id, severity, and treatment site are copied and an id is generated

exception_text: No unhandled exception; the mapper always returns a successful result
